notes: All 36 rows CONFIRMED. Method: fetched the current-version statute pages from le.utah.gov (the xcode index pages load text from versioned content files; the version list doubles as an amendment check — 63G-2-203's only listed version is 'Current Version' C63G-2-S203_20250317, Amended by Ch. 33 2025 GS, so no 2024-2026 fee amendment exists; 63G-2-201's current version is Effective 7/1/2026 as the discover pass stated). Also opened and text-extracted both cited Utah Archives official form PDFs (GRAMA Request for Payment or Prepayment 2025; GRAMA Request Form) and confirmed every form quote verbatim, including the payment form's 'may be longer is extraordinary circumstances' typo and the requester cost-contact question. Every rate item is correctly defers_to_city with null value (Utah sets no per-page/per-item figure for any public body); the only numeric parameters ($50 prepayment trigger, 0.25h free staff time) are verbatim-backed and correctly scoped to all governmental entities incl. political subdivisions; agency-only regimes (63G-2-203(3)(b)/63J-1-504) were not recorded as municipal values. rules.deposit.percent (100% ceiling) rests on the natural reading of 'payment of ... future estimated fees' and carries its own manual_verification flag; kept CONFIRMED as a faithful reading of a hard rule rather than a numberized soft standard. Delegated instruments checked: 63G-2-701 (eff. 5/7/2025), 63G-2-401 (eff. 5/7/2025), 10-8-85.6 (enacted 2005, never amended), both Archives forms.
